annotation.justification: The target clause provides clear and specific instructions: an incoming SYN with an invalid source address must be ignored, and a TCP implementation must silently discard an incoming SYN addressed to a broadcast or multicast address. There is no ambiguity in the language or in the required behavior. The references to MUST-63 and MUST-57 further reinforce the normative nature of the requirements.
